selection: Piecewise-constant authored periods for Vatican City State, established in 1929 before the modelled window; ratings remain local project estimates.
limitations: All numeric ratings are project estimates with low confidence, not source measurements.
Italy-wide or Holy See-wide sports evidence is not inherited automatically.
No football federation membership or organised competition is inferred.
Constitutional, territorial or administrative status is context only, not direct sports-performance evidence.
No rankings, titles or athlete outcomes are used to fit ratings.
